title: HatTrick Hero S
native_title: ハットトリックヒーローＳ
overview:
Goal!! A flawless hyper shot!!

Roaring cheers! Speedy match play! One super play after another! The definitive edition, condensed with the true thrill of soccer!!

HatTrick Hero S is Taito's fast-paced arcade-style soccer game, built on the arcade HatTrick Hero '95. Pick from 42 national teams grouped by region - Europe, South America, Asia, the Americas and Africa - and take them into quick matches, unleashing super shots to beat the keeper.

- 42 national teams
- 1 to 4 players with the multitap
- Backup memory support

GOAL!!
完全無欠のハイパーシュートだ!!

うなる歓声！スピーディーな試合展開！スーパープレイの連続！サッカーの醍醐味を凝縮した決定版!!
